paragraphs: Dataminr sells real-time event, threat, and risk intelligence, running an AI platform that detects events as they unfold across 1 million public data sources. The company says its customers include more than 100 United States government agencies, more than 20 international governments, and two-thirds of the Fortune 50.

First Alert is the government product, reaching users from headquarters to the field by web, mobile, and email, and going directly into government systems through a suite of APIs and connectors. Behind it sit more than 60 purpose-built, specialized LLMs trained on a proprietary archive of historical event data.

Dataminr for Corporate Security tracks incidents around company locations, including offices, manufacturing plants, operations facilities, and retail stores. A separate product, Dataminr for News, serves more than 1,500 newsrooms and 30,000 journalists who use it to find stories faster.

quote.text: From the battlefield to the boardroom, and the command center to the C-suite, Dataminr delivers critical real-time intelligence to protect what matters most.
